non_combinable_rows: historical C3 policy trajectories versus corrected code-feedback cohorts
conclusion: The corrected-interface exploratory and unseen-seed replication lanes crossed from explicit public opportunities to executable code and independent acceptance within their qualified fixtures. In a prospective, non-randomized blind-opportunity contrast, ECDSA and RC4 retained 2/2 session acceptance while ChaCha20 had 0/2 session acceptance and 3/3 rejected candidate verdicts. Historical TLS/SSH policy trajectories independently show 4/10 reserved-oracle acceptance per task. These are separate stage observations, not a pooled success rate, family ranking, causal disclosure estimate, or general capability estimate.
